name: devbench-backlog-assistant
description: Operator-phase backlog-assistant for diagnosis and remediation in the devbench workflow. Ships nine read-only diagnosis skills and payload skills that print mutating commands but never run them without CONFIRM. Supports done-integrity guards and operator-mode amendment review. Use when work units are blocked, backlogs drift, or review is stuck. Pairs with devbench-orchestrate (execution) and devbench-authoring (planning).
